meta.name: formax-semantics-parity-workflow
meta.description: Use when implementing or modifying behavior that must stay consistent across TUI and Web (mode/input/tool/replay/order). Require canonical semantics first, then TUI/Web adapters, then renderer-specific UI.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 保持 TUI 和 Web 双端行为语义一致
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 TUI 和 Web 间同步交互逻辑
copy.tagline_en: Keep behavior semantically consistent across TUI and Web
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to synchronize interaction logic between TUI and Web

howto.what: 当修改需要在 TUI 和 Web 之间保持一致的行为（如模式、输入、工具、回放、排序）时，它会让你先定义规范语义，再更新两端适配器，最后处理特定 UI。
howto.when: 当你需要实现或修改跨 TUI 和 Web 的行为，且涉及模式、输入、工具、回放或排序等方面时触发。

say.text: 我要修改输入模式，请确保 TUI 和 Web 一致。
say.note: 技能将按语义优先流程执行。

say.text: 新增一个工具后，请更新语义契约和两端适配器。
say.note: 确保工具行为在两端一致。

howto.what_en: When modifying behavior that must stay consistent across TUI and Web (mode, input, tool, replay, order), it enforces canonical semantics first, then TUI/Web adapters, and finally renderer-specific UI.
howto.when_en: Triggered when implementing or changing behavior that must remain consistent across TUI and Web, especially mode, input, tool, replay, or ordering.

say_en.text: I want to change input mode, please keep TUI and Web consistent.
say_en.note: The skill will follow semantic-first workflow.

say_en.text: After adding a new tool, please update the semantics contract and both adapters.
say_en.note: Ensures tool behavior is consistent across surfaces.
